Maya (AE): Heads-up: Hearthline Bank paused final procurement signoff. Their list: 4 static egress IPs, 150Mbps per endpoint in eu-west-1, BYO-KMS option, and an audit clause. Need a short tech note + pricing delta for tomorrow's exec review.
Evan (Solutions Eng): Quick clarifier: 150Mbps per endpoint, how many endpoints? and is mTLS mandatory?
Maya (AE): They wrote: '150Mbps per endpoint, up to 3 endpoints. mTLS preferred, willing to accept client certs.'
Lina (Eng-Infra): 3x150Mbps sustained (450Mbps aggregate) suggests Dedicated for long-term SLA. Short-term we can provision pinned-hosted-egress nodes + static IPs, but SRE work required and isolation/SLO risk remains.
Rosa (Security): BYO-KMS is supported on Dedicated/Private. Hosted only allows key-wrapping patterns (proxy) which need attestation and SOC2 review. I'll list required docs.
Diego (Legal): Procurement wants EU data-residency and audit access in SOW. We can add standard language; need retention/logging scope from infra.
Hannah (SalesOps): Pricing note: Hosted + egress addon ~+12% list; Dedicated reserved ~+30% depending on commit. I'll model exact numbers after Lina's runbook.
Evan (Solutions Eng): I'll draft a one-page tech note: network flow, cert distribution, egress ops, test commands, and fallback to Dedicated.
Lina (Eng-Infra): I'll include expected latency/throughput numbers and a minimal test snippet they can run.
Pri (Customer Success): I'll attend the bridge and capture onboarding differences for Hosted vs Dedicated.
exec-ops-bot: Exec bridge request queued — EB-2026-0217. Assigned: VP Sales + Head of Infra.
Maya (AE): CISO bridge scheduled 09:30 BST tomorrow. Please post artifacts by 18:00 PT today so I can share with procurement. If not ready, escalate to exec bridge for 11:00 PT.
Rosa (Security): Maya, send the CISO contact and current security questionnaire answers; I'll mark gaps.
Maya (AE): CISO is ciso@hearthline.bank, procurement is proc@hearthline.bank. Sending questionnaire now.
Diego (Legal): I'll prep the SOW clause and add it to thread.
Evan (Solutions Eng): Note: if their firewall terminates TLS at a proxy we need proxy passthrough for mTLS to work  flagging as a dependency.
Maya (AE): Thanks everyone. Please drop runbook + pricing here by 18:00 PT. :thumbsup:
